foundations.statement: Original E, CM Host, Datum, Level, Coeff, GoodEmb, ordered multiplicity equivalence and supplied Moduli record; no new existence theorem for the moduli scheme.

HUF21 supplies the original FamilyUnif at its stated rank and foundation scope. PUN11 supplies ModelsOf, ModelBase and NegXi with the original fixed Hermitian coordinates and all original arithmetic premises preserved.
HUF20 and HUF21 supply the theta-frame law on every open preconnected base, for the prescribed integral symplectic basis and the same universal line.
HUF1 identifies analytic derivatives with literal dual-number tangent maps; FamilyUnif.ex_diff and equivariance give the actual ordered eigenbasis.
TDR1 identifies the original tangent and IsCombAt predicates with the same Lie eigenbundle frames; it needs no section-base-change premise.
Only the NFR13 FromTest conclusion uses TDR13, with exact SecBaseChangeSt: original locally Noetherian base, arbitrary coefficient target. No stronger AnySt hypothesis.

source.declaration: Exact retained SecBaseChangeSt used only for the NFR13 FromTest corollary

foundations.statement: Finite free modules, duality of unimodular alternating forms, determinants and Hermitian linear algebra. The adapted modulus-eight basis and symplectic lifting required here are proved in NFR3.

Normal convergence, Cauchy/Laurent expansion, identity theorem, elementary finite-dimensional inverse-function arguments, Fubini/Tonelli and linear changes of variables. Theta nonvanishing, coefficient classification, unitary connectedness and Gaussian constants are explicitly proved in NFR2/NFR5/NFR9.

An actual regular section is determined by its complex closed-point values on a reduced finite-type complex scheme; pullback of line bundles and the fiber-product universal property. The actual universal fibers are smooth. No GAGA or new rank-one section theorem is assumed here.
